newsitem.title: UK: NWE low sulphur straight-run steady in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE low sulphur straight-run steady in thin trade.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil was notionally steady on Friday with the effect of stronger crude futures offset by weak buying interest.

One refiner sold 27,000 tonnes at an undisclosed price. He was offering further cargoes of 0.6 percent sulphur material at $108 fob NWE but saw no offers. Trans-Atlantic interest on Thursday stood at offer levels of $101 fob NWE.
Producers were holding out hope that recent run cuts at major European refiners would help support the low sulphur price in the medium term.
"Its very difficult to sell oil right now, despite the screen," said one trader, reflecting general bearishness.
High sulphur straight run markets were seen down, but expected shortfalls of Russian material were predicted to firm prices next week.
